request: chess clock 10 minutes each player

checklist.item: only active player's time runs down

program:
app "Chess clock" clock ink
state t1 dur = 600s
state t2 dur = 600s
state turn num = 0
every 1s if turn = 1 set t1 = t1 - 1s
every 1s if turn = 2 set t2 = t2 - 1s
grid 1 gap 2
  stack card align center pad 4 fill if(turn = 1, accent, soft) tap set turn = 2
    "Player 1" faint
    t1 big color if(t1 < 60s, bad, ink)
  stack card align center pad 4 fill if(turn = 2, accent, soft) tap set turn = 1
    "Player 2" faint
    t2 big color if(t2 < 60s, bad, ink)
button "Pause" tap set turn = 0
button "Reset" tap set turn = 0 then set t1 = 600s then set t2 = 600s
describe:
Chess clock, in the ink colours.
Remembers while you use it: t1, starting at 10 minutes; t2, starting at 10 minutes; turn, starting at 0.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while turn is 1, it sets t1 to t1 minus 1 seconds.
- every 1 seconds while turn is 2, it sets t2 to t2 minus 1 seconds.
- a grid of 1 columns:
  - a group; a tap sets turn to 2:
    - text: "Player 1".
    - text: t1.
  - a group; a tap sets turn to 1:
    - text: "Player 2".
    - text: t2.
- a button "Pause"; a tap sets turn to 0.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets turn to 0, then sets t1 to 10 minutes, then sets t2 to 10 minutes.

program:
app "Tuition" school ocean
table student name text, class text, fee money, discount money = 0
table payment student ref student, amount money
let unpaid = count(student, count(it.payment month) = 0)
unpaid "students are not paid this month" head color if(unpaid > 0, warn, good)

request: carrom scoreboard for two teams, tap to add points, boards played count

program:
app "Carrom" board ink
table point team pick Us|Them, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Us)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Them)
setting winat num = 25 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Us" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Us, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Us, pts = 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Them" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Them, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+2" tap add point team = Them, pts = 2
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Us win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Them win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Carrom, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Us, Them; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- a is the total pts of point where team is Us.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Them.

- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Us, pts set to 2.
- text: "Them".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Them, pts set to 1.
- a button "+2"; a tap adds a point with team set to Them, pts set to 2.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Us win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Them win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
